purpose: Verify official, anonymous parcel geometry and a native parcel identifier at the exact unchanged WUP population point; inspect local city and state/county services.
assessment: Utah UGRC’s official parcel page describes public parcel-boundary polygons, local-government stewardship, and monthly updates for Salt Lake County. The official SGID Salt Lake County basic-parcels FeatureServer returned one polygon whose native PARCEL_ID covers the unchanged WUP point. The separate West Valley City SimpleParcelsCityworks layer was queried for IDs only at that same exact point and returned no IDs; the difference is unresolved. Only one polygon was retained; citywide completeness was not tested.
registryAssessment: Public parcel geometry is available through the Utah SGID/UGRC service. That evidence supports public map geometry and an identifier, not ownership, title, or tax-roll conclusions.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: One exact WUP point in the published Salt Lake County basic-parcels FeatureServer, plus a point-only check of the city SimpleParcelsCityworks layer.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: One parcel polygon returned by an exact-point spatial query in the UGRC-hosted Salt Lake County service.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Utah Parcels data page says SGID contains parcel boundaries for all 29 counties, stewarded by UGRC and local government; the Big 5 including Salt Lake are aimed to be updated monthly. It identifies Salt Lake County basic parcel and feature services; page lists September 2026 update.

officialPrimarySources.operator: Utah SGID / UGRC and local-government steward
officialPrimarySources.observation: Anonymous ArcGIS FeatureServer layer metadata and exact-point geometry query succeeded. Requested only OBJECTID and PARCEL_ID attributes with polygon geometry.

Official city MapServer identifies a West Valley City Parcels layer. A point-only returnIdsOnly query at the unchanged WUP coordinate returned no object IDs; this limited result is not evidence of citywide absence.

attempts: Fetched official UGRC Utah Parcels page; it identifies Salt Lake County basic-parcel and feature-service links and September 2026 currency.
Read UGRC-hosted Salt Lake County FeatureServer layer metadata. The layer is polygon geometry; query capabilities are available; metadata advertises PARCEL_ID as native parcel identifier.
Submitted an exact-point ArcGIS returnIdsOnly query to the Salt Lake County layer using the unchanged WUP coordinate. It returned OBJECTID 187133.
Requested geometry for only OBJECTID 187133 and outFields OBJECTID,PARCEL_ID; HTTP 200, one 423-byte GeoJSON polygon, PARCEL_ID 21182290100000. The WUP coordinate is covered by the returned polygon.
An exact-point returnIdsOnly query to West Valley City’s own SimpleParcelsCityworks layer returned an empty objectIds result; did not request attributes or geometry from that city layer.
A separate small bounding-box ID query on the Salt Lake County layer returned 272 object IDs; these candidates were not bulk-read or retained.

geometryEvidence.exactWupPointTest: Turf point-in-polygon check against the returned native EPSG:4326 geometry was true for the unchanged WUP point [40.6516355964175,-111.987511764721].

requestEvidence.method: GET; anonymous; exact point; returnIdsOnly=true; no parcel attributes or geometry
requestEvidence.assessment: Exact point spatial intersects query yielded OBJECTID 187133; response body was {"objectIdFieldName":"OBJECTID","objectIds":[187133]}.

requestEvidence.method: GET; anonymous; selected one ID only; request OBJECTID and PARCEL_ID only
requestEvidence.assessment: One polygon returned; exact WUP point is inside; only native parcel ID retained.

requestEvidence.method: GET; anonymous; exact point; returnIdsOnly=true; no parcel attributes or geometry
requestEvidence.assessment: No objectIds returned for the point-only query; the query alone does not establish a coverage gap.

nextStep: Root review the official-source evidence and one-polygon sample before integrating the source.
remainingUncertainty: One exact WUP point is verified in SGID, but no citywide completeness or freshness comparison was performed. The city MapServer’s empty point result remains unexplained.
